title: arctanthemum arcticum subsp. kurilense
intro: Arctanthemum arcticum subsp. kurilense, commonly known as Kuril Island sea wormwood, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the sunflower family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, making it a useful natural remedy for various ailments. The therapeutic actions of Arctanthemum arcticum subsp. kurilense include antioxidant, anti-cancer, and wound-healing properties, attributed to its ability to stimulate immune function and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
